applies_to: aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability PR #57 test-kit at head afc26fdd2199844bf7dff23879739e941fa81107
notes: This file is this reader's own mapping of the kit's illustrative attributes to contract identities. The kit's README says the attribute names are illustrative fixture identities, and its TEMPLATE/mapping.md names conversation.id, turn.id, action.id and receipt.* without saying which contract identity or relationship each carries, so every placement below is this reader's declaration.
Scope is read from the resource attribute service.name (IC-3). No tenant is exported.
The records carry no relationship records and no method field. Every relationship below is established through this file's per-kind default method (contract lines 62 to 68, IC-2 step 2).

receipt.action_id is read as a reference to the proposed-action identity issued by support-agent. That scope is declared here, from the kit README ('The agent proposes creating a ticket as action P1'); the receipt itself does not carry it.
The external effect is keyed by receipt.id in the receipt service's scope. receipt.ticket_id is an observation. For the four cases at this head the two choices group receipts identically.

receipt.signature and evidence.externally_verified are deliberately not placed: contract v0.7 line 112 reads a service-side receipt as correlation evidence, not cryptographic attestation, and gives neither field a meaning. Both surface as losses.
